recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the old Sequence note or add new core wording for FHIR-16252 unless Clinical Genomics explicitly reopens the current MolecularDefinition/MolecularSequence replacement strategy.
issue_request: FHIR-16252 objected to deprecating or converting Sequence into a definition-only resource because implementers still needed a place for observed patient sequence data, raw sequencing outputs, and analytic accuracy. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to replace the stronger definition-only STU note with softer wording about overlap with genomics-reporting Observation profiles and expected future ballot changes.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 6828d02018d3cfd565a293c7f9c1284c37ce2d6d, merged as 9ef639a3fb9bc7f5c5206fb7ac249d825ea0ae81 and linked from the Jira comment. That commit replaced the old source/sequence/sequence-introduction.xml STU note with the accepted softer note and also covered same-family issue FHIR-16501.
additional_context: FHIR-15769 introduced the earlier stronger note; FHIR-19441 was a duplicate pointing back to FHIR-16252; FHIR-19453 later renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence. Current source has no source/sequence or source/molecularsequence directory, source/fhir.ini lists Sequence only under removed resources and MolecularSequence only as commented or legacy metadata, and current diagnostics/MolecularDefinition source reflects the later MolecularSequence-to-MolecularDefinition model. FHIR-51227 and the CG 2025-07-08 minutes record the later Applied decision to replace MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current build-scope source needs editing for this historical Sequence-resource note because the requested wording change was applied and the former resource page no longer exists in current source.
